reachable_path: Raw HTTP from another local process/user
Loopback Host check passes, Origin check runs before auth
Quadratic regexp stalls Bridge event loop

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: SECURITY.md includes hosted Studio/imports/exports; scanner-only claims without impact excluded. Reachability and controls reviewed in source at exported commit.

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: Local preauth resource exhaustion, bounded header input

evidence: server.ts:428-470 accepts raw Origin from loopback HTTP and calls originAllowed before token authentication; /health GET alone bypasses it.
originAllowed:88 applies unanchored /\/+$/ to attacker-controlled slash runs ending in a non-slash; repeated start positions cause quadratic scanning.

Bridge binds127.0.0.1 (commands/bridge.ts:63), while token file is private0600 (playout/token.ts:29). Another local user can reach TCP without possessing the token; synchronous scanning delays the shared event loop.
proof_gaps: Ordinary browser Origin cannot be chosen arbitrarily; no remote website path demonstrated. Node header limits bound the per-request cost.
Dynamic timings and listener validation are recorded separately by the fix investigator.
findings.recommended_next_step: fix-finding
findings.fix_finding_handoff: Replace shared trailing slash regex with linear backward scan in allowedOrigins/originAllowed. Preserve exact trim/missing-origin/loopback/allowlist semantics; verify long rejected input and ordinary auth/CORS behavior.
